item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: “60s-70s” Danish package-holiday pig feast: cochinillo asado, crispy roast suckling pig with patatas panaderas (oven-baked potatoes with olive oil, vegetables, white wine and stock) and beer sauce, topped with parsley. Served with ensalada verde of chicory, iceberg, tomatoes and spring onion tossed in olive oil, lemon juice and salt. (6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Paella de marisco, classic Spanish paella with mussels, prawns and squid cooked with Spanish bomba rice and saffron fish stock, topped with parsley. Served with lemon, aioli and a fennel and orange salad with manzanilla olives tossed in olive oil and sherry vinegar. The dish is gluten free. (2+3+5+13+14+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Paella de verduras, classic Spanish paella with seasonal vegetables cooked with Spanish bomba rice and saffron vegetable stock, topped with parsley. Served with lemon, aioli and a fennel and orange salad with manzanilla olives tossed in olive oil and sherry vinegar. The dish is gluten free. (2+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Spanish theme: pollo al chilindrón, a Rioja-style chicken stew in an intense tomato sauce with peppers and serrano ham, served with fried potatoes. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish White beans and portobello mushrooms in the same spiced tomato sauce with peppers. (15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Spanish tortilla with chorizo, red pepper and potato, served with a fresh, tangy salad of fennel, rocket and parsley in a sherry vinaigrette. (2+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Spanish tortilla with mushrooms, red pepper and potato, served with a fresh, tangy salad of fennel and rocket in a sherry vinaigrette. (2+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Albóndigas, Spanish beef meatballs in an umami-rich tomato sauce, served with patatas bravas and topped with herb-roasted vegetables (peppers, courgette and carrot). Served with bravas sauce, aioli, chilli sauce and a green bean salad with roasted tomatoes, manchego and almonds in a red wine vinaigrette. Also available gluten free and dairy free. (1+2+6+9+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: meatballs made from legume and rice protein in an umami-rich tomato sauce, served with patatas bravas and topped with herb-roasted vegetables (peppers, courgette and carrot). Served with bravas sauce, aioli, chilli sauce and a green bean salad with roasted tomatoes, manchego and almonds in a red wine vinaigrette. Gluten free, and also available vegan. (6+9+11+13+15)
